# Trade flow (`trade-flow` v1)

Goods trade between two economies: exports, imports, balance and the main products.

**Group:** Economics · **Mnemonic:** `TFLOW` · **Identifiers:** `TFLOW-…` in `flowId`

Open one with `TFLOW <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: trade-flow
version: 1
description: "Goods trade between two economies: exports, imports, balance and the main products."
match: { kind: trade-flow, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Economics · Trade flow, id: $.flowId }
strip:
  - { label: From, bind: $.reporterName }
  - { label: To, bind: $.partnerName }
  - { label: Exports (USD bn), bind: $.exports, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Imports (USD bn), bind: $.imports, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Balance (USD bn), bind: $.balance, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Average tariff, bind: $.tariff, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: products
    kind: hbar
    title: Main exports (USD bn)
    key: F2
    rows: $.products
    label: product
    value: value
    fmt: amount0
  - id: balanceHistory
    kind: line
    title: Balance (USD bn)
    area: right
    rows: $.balanceHistory
    x: year
    y: balance
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.economy, 'economy')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

| Balance (USD bn) | `$.balance` | `signed0` |
